Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 temp_v_unit_id varchar2(14) := ltrim(:manual_unit_entry_coexist.coll_id) ||
 ltrim(lpad(to_char(:manual_unit_entry_coexist.coll_year),2,'0')) ||
 ltrim(:manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no);
 temp_v_unit_serial_no varchar2(7) := :manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no; 
 temp_v_out_unit_id varchar2(14) := null;
 temp_v_out_chk_digit varchar2(1) := null; 
BEGIN
 default_value(NULL,'GLOBAL.unit_serial_no');
 IF NVL(length(temp_v_unit_serial_no), 0) in ('7','10') 
 AND :manual_unit_entry_coexist.coll_id IS NULL 
 AND :manual_unit_entry_coexist.coll_year IS NULL THEN
 -- Assume it to be a CODABAR unit.
 IF :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no IS NOT NULL THEN 
 IF temp_v_unit_serial_no = :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no THEN
 Validate_Unit_Scan_Codabar('D'||temp_v_unit_id||'D','M','C',temp_v_out_unit_id);
 :GLOBAL.chk_digit := NULL;
 :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no := NULL;
 :GLOBAL.manual_unit_id := temp_v_out_unit_id;
 :GLOBAL.chk_digit := NULL; 
 :GLOBAL.code_scheme := 'C';
 :GLOBAL.coll_id := null;
 :GLOBAL.coll_year := null;
 :GLOBAL.chk_digit := null;
 :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no := NULL;
 go_item(:GLOBAL.field_left);
 ELSE
 IF NVL(length(:manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no), 0) != 
 NVL(length(:GLOBAL.unit_serial_no), 0) THEN
 show_error('0049');
 check_package_failure;
 ELSE
 show_error('0045');
 check_package_failure;
 :GLOBAL.chk_digit := NULL;
 :GLOBAL.code_scheme := 'I';
 :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no := NULL;
 go_item(:GLOBAL.field_left);
 END IF;
 END IF;
 ELSE 
 :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no := :manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no;
 :manual_unit_entry_coexist.coll_id := NULL; 
 :manual_unit_entry_coexist.coll_year := NULL;
 :manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no := NULL;
 :GLOBAL.code_scheme := 'C';
 message('Please re-enter unit ID.',NO_ACKNOWLEDGE); 
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 END IF;
 ELSE 
 --Check for Multiple Codabar / Code 128 Records
 IF :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no IS NULL or
 (:GLOBAL.unit_serial_no IS NOT NULL AND
 :manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no != :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no) THEN
 check_multiple_units(temp_v_unit_id,:global.chapter_id );
 check_package_failure;
 END IF; 
 Validate_unit_scan_Code128(temp_v_unit_id,'M','I',temp_v_out_unit_id,temp_v_out_chk_digit); 
 IF temp_v_out_chk_digit = '*' THEN
 :GLOBAL.chk_digit := temp_v_out_chk_digit;
 :GLOBAL.manual_unit_id := substr(temp_v_unit_id,1,13);
 :GLOBAL.code_scheme := 'I';
 -- go_item(:GLOBAL.field_left);
 ELSE
 :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no := :manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no;
 go_item('user_response.user_response'); 
 raise form_trigger_failure; 
 END IF;
 END IF; 
END;

--This procedure validates check digit for manual entered unit ID and calculates the check digit for scanned unit ID.
PROCEDURE validate_unit_chkdigit(P_unit_id IN Varchar2,
 p_chk_digit OUT Varchar2 )
 
IS
temp_v_len number :=0;
temp_v_chr varchar2(1);
temp_n_A Number :=0;
temp_n_check_value Number:=0;
temp_n_Si Number:=0;

BEGIN
 temp_v_len := NVL(LENGTH ( p_unit_id ), 0) ;
 FOR I in 1 .. temp_v_len 
 LOOP
 temp_v_chr := SUBSTR(p_unit_id,I,1);
 IF( LTRIM(temp_v_chr,'0987654321') IS NULL) THEN
 temp_n_A := ASCII( temp_v_chr) - 48;
 ELSIF ( temp_v_chr = '*' ) THEN
 temp_n_A := 36;
 ELSE
 temp_n_A := ASCII(temp_v_chr) - 55;
 END IF;

 temp_n_Si := MOD(((temp_n_Si+temp_n_A)*2),37);

 END LOOP;
 temp_n_check_value :=MOD((38-temp_n_Si),37);
 -- based on the check_value get the decoded value from the

 p_chk_digit := SUBSTR('0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ*',
 temp_n_check_value+1,1);

END;

ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
-- According to code 128 previous month units has to be carried to the next month in accordance 
--with a tolerance value specified at the chapter level.

--This procedure will validate Collection_year as per Code128 format 
PROCEDURE VALIDATE_COLLECTION_YEAR(p_collection_year in varchar2,
 p_coll_date in date)
IS
 temp_validate_yy number(3);
 temp_collection_year_add number(3);
 temp_collection_year_minus number(3);
BEGIN
 --collection year should be numeric 
 IF( LTRIM( p_collection_year,'0123456789') IS NOT NULL) THEN
 show_error('8020');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 --If the collection year and the system year are same then return back 
 IF ( TO_NUMBER(p_collection_year) = TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(sysdate,'yy') ))THEN
 RETURN;
 END IF;
 -- check the label year should be (+,-) of 1 within the collection year.
 temp_collection_year_add :=TO_NUMBER(p_collection_year) +1;
 temp_collection_year_minus := TO_NUMBER(p_collection_year) -1;
 IF( temp_collection_year_add = 100 ) THEN
 temp_collection_year_add :=0;
 ELSIF ( temp_collection_year_minus = -1) THEN
 temp_collection_year_minus := 99;
 END IF;
 IF ((temp_collection_year_add = TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(sysdate,'yy'))) 
 OR ( temp_collection_year_minus=TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(sysdate,'yy'))) ) THEN 
 NULL;
 ELSE
 show_error('9708');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 -- Select the tolerance 
 DECLARE
 temp_v_global_chapter_id varchar2(5) := NAME_IN('global.chapter_id');
 temp_c_interval VARCHAR2(3);
 BEGIN
 SELECT validate_yy_value 
 INTO temp_validate_yy
 FROM chapters
 WHERE chapter_id =temp_v_global_chapter_id
 AND sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate + 365) ;
 IF( temp_validate_yy = -1)
 OR ( temp_validate_yy IS NULL) THEN
 RETURN; -- No validation required
 END IF;
 IF ( TO_NUMBER(p_collection_year) > TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR( SYSDATE,'yy') ) ) THEN 
 IF (( TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR( p_coll_date,'DDD')) ) > temp_validate_yy) THEN
 show_error('9709');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 ELSIF (TO_NUMBER(p_collection_year) < TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'yy'))) THEN
 /*
 **calculate acceptable interval last day of the year of p_coll_date minus 
 **Julian day of the year for day of p_coll_date
 */
 temp_c_interval := TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(TO_DATE( '31-DEC'||TO_CHAR(p_coll_date,'yy')),'ddd') )-
 TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(p_coll_date,'ddd')); 
 IF( temp_c_interval > temp_validate_yy )THEN
 show_error('9709');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF; 
 END IF; 
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 NULL;-- dont validate
 /*WHEN form_trigger_failure THEN
 raise FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;*/
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 handle_error;
 END;
EXCEPTION
 when form_trigger_failure then
 raise FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE; 
END;
